about: The offertorium of the formulary “Saint Anne, Mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The daughters of kings are in Your honor; the queen stood at Your right hand in gilded clothing, surrounded with variety.

ex.w005: The Church reads the psalm’s bridegroom King as Christ. The queen at His right hand is applied in this Mass to Saint Anne. The pronouns are therefore written as addressed to God.
